reason: The board approved the amalgamation of two wholly owned subsidiaries, which typically streamlines operations and improves consolidated margins.
why_now: The filing was made on October 12, 2026, immediately following the board meeting.
source_headlines: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at the meeting held on October 12, 2026 have approved the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of Zuventus Healthcare Limited and Emcutix Biopharmaceuticals Limited, wholly owned subsidiaries with Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited - Holding Company, subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals.
